item.title: Second submission cycle (Cycle 2) is open
item.description: SynSec 2026 added a second submission cycle. Cycle 2 is now open at https://cycle2.synsec.org with an AoE (UTC-12) deadline of 2026-07-23 23:59:59. Cycle 1 (deadline 2026-05-01) is closed. ai-cfp.json now lists both cycles under submission.cycles; the top-level submission deadline points to the active Cycle 2.

item.title: Venue confirmed: Skysong Innovations, Scottsdale, AZ
item.description: Conference location updated from Phoenix to Scottsdale, Arizona; venue is Skysong Innovations. ai-cfp.json updated accordingly.
